start.description: Temperature and rain for the next 12 hours.
start.btn_about_aria: About this app (version, release notes & sources)
start.btn_about_tooltip: About this app (version, release notes & sources)
start.offline: Offline: the forecast cannot be refreshed
config.title: Settings
config.introduction_general: These settings apply everywhere in the app
config.introduction_forecast: Choose what the forecast card shows
config.hint_hourly: Hourly rows need a tall enough screen.
config.hint_units: Never set? Using your current location picks the usual units of its country.
about.title: About Meteo
about.support_description: Meteo is free, open source, and ad-free. If you find the app valuable, consider supporting its development and hosting.
about.guide_description: A sample forecast with every option on. The numbers match the list below.
about.guide_summary_desc: When rain starts and its heaviest hour, then the temperature range. With the wind setting, the strongest wind and gusts from {gust}. With the sky setting, an icon shows the current sky.
about.guide_amount_desc: Rain or snow expected in that hour ({rain_unit}). Shown from {wet}.
about.guide_bar_desc: Grows with the rain amount. A full bar is the wettest hour, or {scale} on drier days.
about.guide_chance_desc: Probability of more than {wet} of rain or snow in that hour.
about.guide_hour_desc: Start of each hour; the first column, the current hour, reads “Now”. Phones label every second hour.
about.guide_sky_desc: Sky condition of each hour, with these icons. Needs the sky setting and a tall enough screen.
about.guide_icon_clear_day_desc: Clear or mainly clear sky by day.
about.guide_icon_clear_night_desc: Clear or mainly clear sky after dark.
about.guide_icon_rain_desc: Drizzle, rain or showers, also freezing.
about.guide_icon_snow_desc: Snowfall, snow grains or snow showers.
about.guide_temp_desc: Air temperature at the start of each hour, in {temp_unit}.
about.guide_wind_desc: Wind speed 10 m above the ground at the start of each hour, in {wind_unit}. The arrow points where the wind blows to. Needs the wind setting and a tall enough screen.
about.guide_place_desc: The searched place, or your current location with its town when found.
about.guide_updated_desc: When the forecast was fetched. Returning to the app refreshes it once it is 15 minutes old.
about.icons_description: Overview of interface icons and their functions:
about.icon_search_desc: Show the search field again to pick another place.
about.icon_config_desc: Choose the language, theme, color accent and what the forecast shows.
about.icon_about_desc: View this guide, sources, release notes and support links. Shortcut: F1.
about.icon_install_desc: Install Meteo as an app on your phone or computer.
forecast.summary_rain: Rain expected from {time} (up to {max} {unit} per hour).
forecast.summary_rain_now: Rain expected now (up to {max} {unit} per hour).
forecast.summary_dry: No rain expected in the next 12 hours.
forecast.summary_wind_gusts: Wind up to {speed} {unit}, gusts up to {gusts} {unit}.
forecast.error_empty: Enter a place name or postal code.
forecast.error_geo_denied: Location access was denied. Allow it in your browser, or search for a place.
forecast.error_geo_unavailable: Your location could not be determined. Search for a place instead.
forecast.error_geo_timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again or search for a place.
forecast.error_geo_unsupported: This browser cannot share your location. Search for a place instead.
forecast.error_network: The forecast service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
forecast.error_http: The forecast service is not available right now. Try again later.
forecast.error_bad_response: The forecast service sent an unexpected answer. Try again later.
about.icon_location_desc: Show the forecast for where you are; only the coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo and OpenStreetMap.
about.source_forecast_description: Hourly temperature, rain and chance of rain from national weather services (CC BY 4.0).
about.source_geocoding_description: Place and postal code search based on GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).
about.source_reverse_description: Name of the current location from OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).
